title: OpenMedia CLI
description: An intelligent CLI tool for media processing with FFmpeg. Features AI-powered command generation, safety review, and deterministic fallbacks for common operations.

title: Cognitive Digital Twin
description: A cognitive digital twin for rice yield prediction and crop-failure risk assessment. Fuses a dual-track stacked ensemble (LSTM-attention + XGBoost) with real-time weather data, biophysical trigger detection, and an LLM-powered advisory layer, all served through an interactive dashboard.
